contexts.text: Deadly hatred reigns in the World of Spirits...
What is regnant with man (is in his least thoughts)... What is regnant with him manifests itself there by a sphere.
With evil Spirits reigns the love of self.
In order to reign with them, they offer their services to good Spirits.
In reigning shalt thou reign over us... () = were they to be subject as to the things of the Intellectual? Explained.
(This) is what is universally regnant, and that which reigns universally is not apperceived except when the thought is determined there. Example(s).
That which reigns universally produces this sphere.
The sphere which reigns in Heaven...
For what a man loves, reigns; not what he only knows.
For truths to be conjoined, good must be universally regnant; for what reigns universally, conjoins.
The external man then reigns.
Unless good is the end, that is, reigns universally in everything.
What man has for an end... reigns universally in him...
What is regnant is there exhaled from his sphere.
That the fear, or love, of Him, should reign universally.
The affection of good becomes the universal regnant with him; and what reigns universally, reigns singularly. Explained.
The universal Regnant first comes forth when each and all things are such...
At last (the evil) becomes what is universally regnant with him. Explained.
The Divine end for good reigns universally.
What he intends, reigns with him. Explained.
What inflows from Heaven, and reigns universally, reveals itself in all freedom.
This only substance reigns in its formations...
What is negative reigns...
That mere fallacies... will reign with them. Signified, Explained. AC 7295.
When falsity begins to reign.
When the loves of self and the world reign...
(These loves) begin to reign when...
That falsity will reign in everything in the Natural... Signified, Explained.

It is then said to reign with him; and the affection itself is called reigning. That is called universally regnant which infills his whole mind, that is, both his thought and his will. That which the man loves above everything else... is such a Regnant... What that is which reigns universally, may be known from his delight when it succeeds, and his pain when it fails. That which reigns universally with a man makes the image of his spirit: his face is altogether according to it. Example(s). AC 8067:end.
Jehovah shall reign to... eternity () = that He is the sole Lord of Heaven and earth.
Of the Angels it is indeed said that they will reign, but from the Lord; thus the Lord through them.
The ancient saying God reigns, and also God shall reign to eternity = that it is well with the Church I because good and truth from the Divine are there... Illustrated.
For the universal Regnant in Heaven is good.
The Lord as to the Divine Human reigning universally in everything of good and truth. Signified, Explained.
This is said first because it must be the universally Regnant in everything which follows. Explained.
That the things which precede will reign in those which follow. Example(s).

That is universally regnant with man which is in everything of his thought and of his will, consequently which constitutes his very mind or life. Such a Regnant must the Lord be with man; for such a Regnant is He with the Angels, of whom it is therefore said that they are in the Lord. The Lord becomes regnant when it is not only believed that all good and truth are from Him, but it is also loved to be so... When the Lord reigns universally with the man of the Church... then He is in all the truths and goods of faith with him as the heart is in all the blood vessels...
Such Spirits and Angels are with man as is his universal Regnant; because the universally Regnant is the esse of the life of everyone. Explained.
The universal Regnant is that which is in each and all things. References.
For everyone has truths according to... what universally reigns with him.
What is perpetually in the thought is what universally reigns there. Explained.
That which universally reigns, is that which has been insinuated into the will itself...
The things which are said to reign universally with man. Explained.
These loves reign with every man before he has been regenerated.
Hence the Lord reigns also in the Hells.
Such a sphere reigns in the external form in Hell.
For the universal Regnant in Divine truths is Divine good; and that which universally reigns, conjoins.
The good of love... reigns in the Inmost Heaven; the good of charity... in the Middle one; and the good of faith in the Ultimate one. Signified.
Good reigns in the Celestial Kingdom; truth in the Spiritual...
Good universally reigning also in the Spiritual Heaven. Signified, Explained.
The universally Regnant is that which is dominant; and thus is that which is in each and all things. References.
In the other life, all look to the things which reign in their interiors...
(Thus) the reigning delight in Hell is the delight of adultery.
To reign upon the earth () = to be in the Lord's Kingdom, and there one with Him. Explained. ( = to be in truths and goods, and thence in power to resist evils and falsities. AE 333.)
To reign with Christ () = to be in the Lord's Kingdom. AR 855. AR 941.
The Lord alone reigns; and everyone in Heaven who is in a function, discharges his office in his Society, as in the world; but under the Lord's auspices. Explained.
To reign with Christ, means to be wise and do uses. Explained.
To the things which reign in the mind... are bent all things they hear. Explained.
Those who have not openly studied to reign... SE 1808.
They want to reign on earth and in Heaven...
There remains the reigning persuasion, thus the reigning cupidity.
How he could reign in secret...
To reign = to have power and wisdom from the Lord. Explained.
These are what the Lord reigns by. Explained.
To reign, when said of the Lord, = to dominate by Divine truth.
Dominion is said of good; and to reign, of truth. Illustrated.
